class.name: DefaultScrollBar
class.brief_description: Default scroll bar: track + thumb, draggable, auto-hides.
class.description:
DefaultScrollBar is the built-in scroll bar: it draws a track and a thumb sized by the viewport / content ratio, lets the user drag the thumb to scroll (or click the track to jump), and fades out when the list is idle. When the content fits the viewport (nothing to scroll), it hides entirely — no track, no thumb, no input — regardless of [member auto_hide]. It can be subclassed to tweak the look.
[codeblock] recycler_view.set_scroll_bar(DefaultScrollBar.new()) [/codeblock]
The bar uses the [code]scroll[/code] / [code]grabber[/code] theme styleboxes when present, with the [member track_color] / [member thumb_color] as fallback.

method.name: get_thumb_rect
method.description: Returns the current thumb rect in local coordinates (empty when the content fits the viewport).

members.member: Whether the bar fades out when the list is idle (default true).
Corner radius of the track / thumb (default 2).
Seconds the bar stays visible after the last activity before fading (default 0.5).
Thumb color, used as fallback when the theme has no [code]grabber[/code] stylebox.
Track color, used as fallback when the theme has no [code]scroll[/code] stylebox.
